title: Directory submission and listing verification round — 17 September 2026
publisher: Council of AI (CSOAI Ltd, UK Companies House 16939677)
principle: Every row is a probe of the DIRECTORY, never of our own filesystem or of a note we hold. LISTED_VERIFIED is recorded ONLY where an anonymous fetch returned our entry; the probe command is printed so it can fail. A record that says we are listed and cannot produce the bytes is a claim, not a measurement.
doctrine_observed: No listing was paid for. Where a directory wanted money the row records REQUIRES_PAYMENT and nothing was bought — that is the owner's spend decision.
No account was created in CSOAI Ltd's name. Where sign-in was compulsory the row records REQUIRES_ACCOUNT with the URL.

No CAPTCHA or bot check was completed by this agent. One directory (futuretools.io) carried a Cloudflare Turnstile that self-verified passively on page load; it was not interacted with, and the row says so.
No certification, endorsement, partnership or membership was claimed in any submission. C2PA and DIF membership were NOT asserted anywhere — that question is under query with the Linux Foundation.
No github.com URL was cited in any submission text. github.com/CSOAI-ORG returns 404 to anonymous readers (probed this round), so a github link in a public directory is a dead link.
Submissions were paced at no more than one per minute.
APPLIED is not ACCEPTED and LISTED is not MEMBER. SUBMITTED rows below were each re-probed anonymously after submission and are NOT yet listed; they are recorded as SUBMITTED for that reason.

state_vocabulary.LISTED_VERIFIED: An anonymous fetch of the directory returned our entry. The probe is recorded.
state_vocabulary.SUBMITTED: A submission was accepted by the directory (confirmation page recorded) and an anonymous re-probe shows we are not yet published.
state_vocabulary.NOT_LISTED: An anonymous, exhaustive probe of the directory's own index returned nothing for us.
state_vocabulary.REQUIRES_ACCOUNT: Submission or verification is gated behind sign-in. Not attempted.
state_vocabulary.REQUIRES_PAYMENT: The only route to a listing costs money. Not attempted.
state_vocabulary.REQUIRES_PUBLIC_REPO: Submission mandates a public source-repository URL. We cannot satisfy this without citing github.com/CSOAI-ORG, which 404s anonymously.
state_vocabulary.NOT_ELIGIBLE: We do not meet a stated technical precondition. Submitting anyway would be a false claim.
state_vocabulary.NO_SUBMISSION_ROUTE: The directory has no open submission surface (closed, curated, or not a directory).

premise_tested.claim: A plain scripted GET on councilof.ai returns 403 (Cloudflare bot management) while browsers get 200, so directories that validate our URL with a script may see a 403.
evidence: curl with the default UA, an empty UA, python-requests/2.31.0, Go-http-client/2.0 and node all returned HTTP 200 on https://councilof.ai/ .
/.well-known/agent-card.json, /api/gspc, /mcp and /robots.txt each returned 200 to plain curl.

Three independent third-party probers reached us successfully this round: x402-list.com recorded last_checked_at 2026-09-17T07:53:24Z with uptime_24h 100 and compliance grade A (14/14); a2aregistry.org reports is_healthy true; PayAI's facilitator holds six live councilof.ai resources.
No directory rejected us for an unreachable URL in this round.
premise_tested.note: The 403 premise should be treated as stale until a fresh reproduction is produced. A directory rejection blamed on it would need its own evidence.

findings.finding: Three entries on the already-listed list could not be confirmed and two are affirmatively absent.
findings.detail: OSS AI Hub: their own sitemap-0.xml carries 4965 URLs and not one matches council, csoai or gspc — NOT_LISTED. Apify Store: the public store API returns no actor matching csoai, gspc or council of ai — NOT_LISTED. Dealroom: returns 403 to every anonymous fetch, so the claim can be neither confirmed nor refuted without an account.
findings.why_it_matters: A listing believed held but absent is worse than a known gap: it stops anyone from submitting.

findings.finding: github.com/CSOAI-ORG returns 404 to anonymous readers, and our live directory listings link to it.
findings.detail: Probed 2026-09-17: github.com/CSOAI-ORG = 404, github.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai = 404, api.github.com/orgs/CSOAI-ORG = Not Found. The MCP Registry carries hundreds of io.github.CSOAI-ORG/* servers whose repository.url points at that 404. MCPVault's entry for us sets logoUrl to https://github.com/CSOAI-ORG.png?size=128 — a broken image. The awesome-mcp-servers README links us twice via github.com/CSOAI-ORG/... .
findings.why_it_matters: Dead links in a directory are worse than no listing, and they also close three submission routes outright (mcp.directory, mcp.so, OSS AI Hub all mandate a repository URL).
findings.recommendation: The MCP Registry supports DNS-based namespace authentication. Republishing under a councilof.ai namespace instead of io.github.CSOAI-ORG would remove the dead link without needing a public GitHub org.

findings.finding: Live listings carry stale counts and stale tool numbers.
findings.detail: Agentry's entry for us says '22 axes, 22 measured'. GET /api/gspc on 2026-09-17 returns axes 23, measured_axes 22, unmeasured_axes 1 — the listing silently drops the UNMEASURED slot, which is exactly the number doctrine says must travel with the other two. The awesome-mcp-servers README says 'Seven read-only tools' and pins npx csoai-gspc-mcp@0.1.1; the live MCP reports 9 free plus 4 paid tools at server version 1.4.2, and npm latest is 0.2.2.
findings.why_it_matters: A directory that publishes a slot count without the unmeasured count is claiming measurements that do not exist, in our name.

findings.finding: mcpservers.org — a directory we are listed in — is itself invisible to scripted readers.
findings.detail: Every anonymous curl, including with a full browser User-Agent, returns HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' interstitial. Verification required a real browser. Our entry is genuinely there (two servers).
findings.why_it_matters: Any future automated re-verification of that row will report a false NOT_LISTED unless it uses a browser.

directories.name: MCP.Directory
directories.evidence: The form's only required field is 'GitHub Repository URL'; npm, PyPI, description and email are optional. They auto-detect name, description, language, license, tools and README from the repo. No account and no fee. Review and publication within 24 hours.
directories.blocker: The mandatory field is a github.com URL. Ours 404s anonymously, so submitting one would plant a dead link — the exact thing doctrine forbids.
directories.unblock: Make a public repo (or publish under a DNS namespace) and this becomes a same-day, no-account, no-fee listing. Best single unblock in this round.
